description: This PHP class 'AuthProviderDao' provides data access methods for managing OpenID authentication providers, including retrieval, saving, and deletion of provider data within an HRM system.

classes.name: AuthProviderDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for managing OpenID authentication providers, including CRUD operations and search functionalities.

methods.name: getAuthProviderById
methods.description: Retrieves an OpenIdProvider entity by its provider ID.

methods.name: getAuthProviderDetailsByProviderId
methods.description: Fetches extra details for a specific provider ID.

methods.name: getAuthProviders
methods.description: Returns a list of authentication providers based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getAuthProvidersPaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginator object for providers based on search filters.

methods.name: getAuthProviderCount
methods.description: Counts the number of providers matching search filters.

methods.name: deleteProviders
methods.description: Deletes (disables) providers by setting their status to false.

methods.name: saveAuthProviderExtraDetails
methods.description: Persists extra details for an authentication provider.

methods.name: getAuthProvidersForLoginPage
methods.description: Retrieves active providers for login page display.
